import hashlib,importlib.util,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('holdout','scripts/run_ti2r_solute_locked_holdout.py')
r=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(r)
root=Path.cwd()
old='artifacts/evidence/TI2R_SOLUTE_HOLDOUT/frozen-manifest.json'
m=json.loads(r.safe._read_regular(root,old))
m['head_sha']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()
m['authorization_id']='TI2R_SOLUTE_PREFLIGHT_REPAIR_1'
m['initial_checkpoint']=r.CHECKPOINT
m['current_authorization']={'first_scientific_holdout_execution':True,'maximum_scientific_executions':1,'automatic_retry':False,'ti3_plus_authorized':False,'merge_authorized':False,'allowed_assets':sorted(r.ASSET_IDS)}
m['counter_history']={'PREVIOUS_CLI_INVOCATIONS':1,'PREVIOUS_SCIENTIFIC_HOLDOUT_EXECUTIONS':0}
m['ci_evidence']=json.loads(r.safe._read_regular(root,r.EVIDENCE+'/verification.json'))['ci_evidence']
m['operational_hashes']={path:hashlib.sha256(r.safe._read_regular(root,path)).hexdigest() for path in sorted(r.OPERATIONAL_PATHS)}
configs={name:json.loads(r.safe._read_regular(root,path)) for name,path in (('v1',r.V1_CONFIG),('v2',r.V2_CONFIG))}
encoded=r.encode_manifest(m,configs)
roundtrip=json.loads(encoded)
assert r.safe._exact(roundtrip['configurations'],configs)
fields=('minimum_entropy_bits','saturation_low_y','saturation_high_y','median_limit_px','p95_limit_px','maximum_limit_px')
assert all(type(roundtrip['configurations']['v1'][field]) is float for field in fields)
for path,digest in m['scientific_hashes'].items():
 raw=r.safe._read_regular(root,path)
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==digest
 assert raw==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',r.C1+':'+path])
r.safe._write_exclusive(root,r.MANIFEST,encoded)
hashes={**m['scientific_hashes'],**m['operational_hashes'],r.MANIFEST:hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}
r.safe._write_exclusive(root,r.EVIDENCE+'/frozen-hashes.sha256',''.join(digest+'  '+path+'\n' for path,digest in sorted(hashes.items())).encode())
# Complete read-only operational preflight; this never creates a receipt or reader.
checked,_,assets,versions,_=r.preflight(root)
assert checked==encoded and len(assets)==8
print(json.dumps({'PRE_HOLDOUT_GATE':'PASS','head_sha':m['head_sha'],'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),'scientific_frozen_files':len(m['scientific_hashes']),'operational_hashes':len(m['operational_hashes']),'checksum_count':len(hashes),'field_types':{field:type(roundtrip['configurations']['v1'][field]).__name__ for field in fields},'field_values':{field:roundtrip['configurations']['v1'][field] for field in fields},'dependencies':versions,'operational_preflight_calls':1,'runner_cli_invocations_this_authorization':0,'scientific_executions':0,'experimental_opens':0,'experimental_bytes':0},indent=2))
